Chapter 6158: Immortal Suppression Fist

Chapter 6158: Immortal Suppression Fist

“Immortal Suppression Fist!” Cultivators were horrified at this sight.

“It can kill emperors in one strike.” Someone said.

Emperors stood on top of the food chain in Sin. There was an insurmountable gap between them and everyone else. Thus, the latter had no chance of killing one.

However, Immortal Suppression’s special fist technique could do so effortlessly.

“It’s an imitation of Heaven Suppression Gauntlet.” One emperor had a serious expression.

“The one belonging to Visceraless Young Noble?” A junior asked.

“Yes, that gauntlet is feared by even supreme overlords, not just primal ancestors.” The emperor nodded.

“I heard Visceraless Young Noble used it to kill Dragonblood Ancestor.” An old ancestor said: “He became invincible, surviving both Immortals Slaughtered and Nightwatch.”

“I see.” Listeners stared at the fist and asked: “I wonder how this compares to the actual gauntlet.”

The legend of Heaven Suppression Gauntlet traveled far and wide. The young noble was able to fight against Moshi and Dingtian with its help.

“Boom!” The fist descended and brought darkness to the world.

The areas outside of Immortal Suppression couldn’t handle the influx of power. Mountains crumbled immediately.

“Damn!” Others were scared out of their mind.

Nevertheless, the controllers of the fist only prioritized Li Qiye’s area. Otherwise, Sin would have faced untold destruction.

The shockwaves pulsed outward and sent cultivators flying despite being relatively far away. Some were reduced to blood.

“We underestimated it.” An ancestor who was fortunate enough to survive turned pale.

They were more than ten million miles away, not to mention Li Qiye being the sole target.

“Bam!” Space and time along with all laws around Li Qiye disintegrated.

“Is he dead?!” Spectators tried their best to observe the void.

“Apex emperors couldn’t kill him, this fist can’t as well.” An emperor said.

Sure enough, once the dust settled, Li Qiye blocked the fist with one hand.

“Too weak, unworthy of the name.” Li Qiye smiled and made a reverse motion, pushing the fist to the ground.

“Bam!” It struck the grand momentum below and everything exploded.

Numerous members of Immortal Suppression also exploded into blood since they were connected with the dynasty’s momentum. Blood rained down and formed rivers.

This scene sent chills down the spectators’ spine. A hundred thousand mighty cultivators fell just now to their own attack.

“He’s monstrous, how terrifying.” The scent of blood wafted in the air and reached everyone’s nostrils.

“This is finally happening to Immortal Suppression.” A desolate god gloated: “They have always been the ones destroying people, now it’s time for them to be annihilated.”

Many shared this sentiment due to Immortal Suppression’s brutal history.

“That’s Hidden Ancestor for you, I think he can erase Immortal Suppression from Sin.” An ancient ancestor murmured.

“No emperor can stop him since even Specter Ancestor had lost.” A desolate god said: “They will all die today.”

Such words made listeners break out in goosebumps. Phantom’s emperors were first and now, the emperors of Immortal Suppression seemed destined to meet a similar fate.

“This is it?” Li Qiye casually strolled through the shattered world beneath.

“You dare enter the gate of hell?” Someone shouted and a massive arched gate descended to block Li Qiye’s path.

A thick mist surged outward; even emperors wouldn’t be able to see their hands raised in front of them. It immediately enveloped the dynasty in just a second.
